title: Docs lock ComponentsPiece architecture + contracts
goal: Park architecture, storage layout, and minimal contracts in docs/ without implementing APIs.

title: Customers DB row host customerNumber approved
goal: Persist host -> customerNumber with approved flag and DNS-approval cache fields.

title: S3 customer tree bootstrap empty live.json
goal: On first sight create x:/{customerNumber}/ tree with site placeholders and empty live.json for uri-slug.

title: Parts API GET /parts offset limit page
goal: GET /parts?host&uri&offset&n returns customerNumber, parts slice from live.json, nextOffset.

title: Click API GET /go approved path
goal: Approved host GET /go?host&uri&part returns affiliate destination from live.json.

title: Click API DNS TXT gate signup and approval cache
goal: Unapproved: TXT present marks approved and returns destination; TXT absent returns signup URL only; cache so DNS not hit every click.

title: Widget JS capture host uri page Parts API
goal: Ship embeddable widget that captures location.host + pathname (relevant search), pages Parts API, supports horizontal|vertical|fullscreen layout attribute.

title: Widget inherit host CSS no competing theme
goal: Widget CSS is layout-only; no brand color/font theme that fights the host.

title: Widget click via /go never embed affiliate URL
goal: View deal triggers GET /go and opens returned url; part cards do not contain affiliate hrefs.

title: Agent site pass site.md and seed top10.json
goal: First agent pass on customer without site.md writes affiliate skillbook into site.md and seeds top10.json.

title: Agent URI context.md and searches.json
goal: Per URI folder maintain context.md and a small searches.json aimed at cheapest relevant queries.

title: Agent ingest in.json into live.json then delete
goal: Read normalised in.json, append relevant parts to live.json, delete consumed in.json. Agent is only writer of live.json.

title: Agent prune dead links and roll top10.json
goal: Drop outdated/broken links from live.json; promote best deals into top10.json.

title: CDK API Gateway routes for /parts and /go
goal: Expose GET /parts and GET /go on the HTTP API with IAM/lambda wiring; synth clean.

title: Park ComponentsPiece HTML mocks and vision Screens rows
goal: Add docs/mocks/components-piece/{home,empty,error}.html and Screens rows; keep gateway mocks.

title: Skillbook folder for components-piece agent CWD
goal: Add AGENTS.md + .grok/skills/a-search-components-piece/SKILL.md so an agent can maintain widget/API/agent tree in isolation.

title: uri-slug stable encoding helper
goal: Stable uri-slug from path (+ query when intent-changing) with tests for collisions and reserved chars.

title: JSON contract fixtures in.json live.json searches.json
goal: Checked-in fixtures + schema pins for in/live/searches item shapes used by agent and Parts API.
